title: Bounded conjunction and proper-basis algorithms
summary: Bounded-support and consistent selector-expansion laws for decoder DAGs, with complete native detection executions and checked emitted witnesses for bounded live conjunctions and proper bases. Selected time inequalities give a general XP bound, a polynomial bound for one live conjunction, and an FPT bound for healthy-one roots. Concrete source construction, total time and temporary word-storage proofs are supplied as companion declarations.
